Shows your **Blue Current** charge points (Netherlands, Belgium) in Gladys,
in real time, through the official API Blue Current makes for home
automation (the one of its Home Assistant integration).

**Never tested with a real account**: this integration was written from the
library Blue Current publishes for Home Assistant, and tested against
simulated answers only. Not affiliated with Blue Current.

## What you get

One Gladys device per charge point, with:

- **Status**: available, charging, blocked, error, offline;
- **Connector** and **charging state** (the charging-station features of Gladys);
- **Vehicle**: no vehicle, vehicle connected, ready to charge, error;
- **Power** (W), **current** and **voltage** per phase (L1, L2, L3);
- **Energy of the session** (kWh), **duration of the session** (minutes),
  **cost of the session** (€, when Blue Current gives it: it documents this
  value as disabled for now), **maximum current** (A).

And, only if you allow them (see below):

- **Start a session** and **Stop the session** (buttons);
- **Availability** (a list: available / blocked), to block or unblock the
  charge point;
- **Reboot the charge point** (a button), behind its own option.

The commands are buttons and a list, never on/off switches: a "turn
everything off" of a voice assistant or a scene cannot reach them.

## Create the API token

1. Sign in to the Blue Current driver portal,
   [my.bluecurrent.nl](https://my.bluecurrent.nl), with the account of your
   charge point.
2. Open the settings, then **Advanced**, and create the **Home Assistant
   API token**. (The Blue Current app may offer it too; not verified.)
3. Copy the token.

## Set up

1. In Gladys, open the integration, paste the token in **Blue Current API
   token**, save. The token is kept by Gladys in its database, never shown
   again, and sent only to Blue Current.
2. The status says how many charge points Blue Current lists. Open the
   **Discovery** tab and add them.
3. To use the commands, turn on **Allow the commands** (start, stop, block,
   unblock) and, separately, **Allow rebooting the charge point**. Both are
   off by default.

## Good to know

- **One connection**: Blue Current pushes the changes, nothing is polled. A
  lost connection comes back by itself, after a few seconds then longer and
  longer (up to 10 minutes).
- **Daily request limit**: Blue Current limits the requests per day. When it
  is reached, the integration waits until midnight (Amsterdam time) before
  connecting again, even after a restart.
- **"Already open elsewhere"**: Blue Current may refuse a second connection
  (another Gladys, a Home Assistant with the same account). The integration
  then waits at least two minutes between tries.
- **"Slow down" (HTTP 429)**: the integration waits for the time Blue
  Current asks (between 1 minute and 6 hours, 15 minutes when it says
  nothing), even after a restart.
- **Refused token**: when Blue Current refuses the token, or refuses the
  connection within 30 minutes of accepting the token, the integration stops
  and tries again after 6 hours, then every 24 hours. Save a new token, or
  click **Test the connection**, to try again at once.
- **How the integration introduces itself**: the Blue Current API asks each
  client for its kind in its first message (`HELLO`). The integration sends
  `homeassistant`, the only value Blue Current documents (that of the library
  it publishes for Home Assistant), and never tries another one; its own
  name, `gladys-blue-current` and its version, goes in the User-Agent of the
  connection.
- **Commands**: before each one, the status of the charge point is read
  again; the command is refused if it cannot be read or if the charge point
  is offline. Nothing is sent when there is nothing to do (start while
  charging, stop without a vehicle, block a charge point already blocked):
  Gladys then shows success. A session is started only with a vehicle plugged
  in ("plug in the vehicle first" otherwise), with the default charge card of
  the charge point, as Blue Current gives it. One command at a time, except
  **Stop the session**, which never waits. Gladys waits 5 seconds: if Blue
  Current has not confirmed by then, Gladys shows "Command sent, without
  confirmation" (or "sent and received, without a result from the charge
  point"): the command may have been carried out, the state follows.
- **Reboot**: the charge point restarts and a session in progress is cut.
- The power is the sum, over the phases, of voltage times current (the Home
  Assistant integration shows a slightly different estimate).
- **Not handled yet**: smart charging, plug and charge, linked cards only,
  the choice of the charge card, the grid status (building load).

## Privacy

The integration talks only to Blue Current
(`wss://motown.bluecurrent.nl`). It never logs the token. In `/data` it keeps
only the end of a request-limit pause and, after a refusal, a hash of the
refused token with the time of the next try.

## Konfigurationseinstellungen

Diese Einstellungen fragt Blue Current in seinem Konfigurationsbildschirm in Gladys ab.

| Einstellung | Typ | Pflichtfeld | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Your Blue Current account | `section` | Nein | Shows your Blue Current charge points in Gladys through the official Blue Current API (the one of Home Assistant), in real time: status, vehicle, power, current and voltage per phase, energy, duration and cost of the session. Create an API token on my.bluecurrent.nl (Advanced, Home Assistant API token), paste it below, save, then add the charge points from the Discovery tab. Starting, stopping, blocking and rebooting from Gladys need the options below, off by default. Never tested with a real account. Not affiliated with Blue Current. |
| Blue Current API token | `secret` | Ja | Created on my.bluecurrent.nl, Advanced, Home Assistant API token. Kept by Gladys in its database, never shown again, sent only to Blue Current. |
| Allow the commands | `boolean` | Nein | Off by default. On: Gladys may start a session (with the default charge card of the charge point), stop it, and block or unblock the charge point. Off: these features refuse every command. |
| Allow rebooting the charge point | `boolean` | Nein | Off by default. A heavy action: the charge point restarts and a session in progress is cut. On: the Reboot button of each charge point works. |
| Language of the feature names | `select` | Nein | Used for the feature names of the devices added from now on, for the status texts and for the command errors. |

## So installierst du Blue Current in Gladys

1. Öffne in Gladys **Integrationen**: Blue Current erscheint im Katalog neben den nativen Integrationen, mit einem Community-Badge.
2. Klicke auf **Installieren**. Gladys lädt das Docker-Image (`ghcr.io/lm1lc3n7/gladys-blue-current:0.1.1`) herunter, startet es in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox und erzeugt die Oberfläche der Integration (Geräte, Erkennung und Konfiguration).
3. Öffne den Bildschirm **Konfiguration** der Integration, fülle die Einstellungen aus und speichere.
4. Du kannst sie auch direkt über die URL ihres Repositorys installieren: [https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-blue-current](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7/gladys-blue-current).

Blue Current benötigt Gladys `>=4.86.0`. Der Katalog in Gladys wird stündlich aktualisiert, eine neue Version ist also spätestens eine Stunde nach ihrer Veröffentlichung verfügbar.

Du nutzt Gladys noch nicht? Es ist kostenlos und Open Source: [folge der Installationsanleitung](/de/docs/), um loszulegen.

## Über externe Integrationen

Blue Current ist eine **externe Integration**: eine Community-Integration, die als Docker-Container verpackt und auf GitHub veröffentlicht wird. Gladys installiert sie mit einem Klick und führt sie in einer vom Kern isolierten Sandbox aus. Sie wird von [LM1LC3N7](https://github.com/LM1LC3N7) veröffentlicht und gepflegt, nicht vom Gladys-Kernteam.
